overview: The big AI story is Anthropic putting about 5% of its shares into a new Public Benefit Fund, which could grow to roughly 20% of all shares counting earlier pledges; Musk and Sacks both pushed back. Elsewhere, Musk heavily promoted Tesla's new Roadster and Grok Bot, and Sacks argued that AI safety filters hurt cyber defenders. A large share of the feed, mostly Bill Ackman reposts, was politics and footage of European riots, which is skipped here.

top_items.title: AnthropicAI - New Public Benefit Fund starts with 5% of shares and can grow 2% per 50% valuation rise; ~20% of equity now pledged
DavidSacks - OpenCode, under attack, found frontier models refused to analyze exploits; Sacks says Chinese models are 6-9 months behind
elonmusk - Musk says new Tesla Roadster out-accelerates a carrier-launched fighter jet, citing claimed >80 kN cold-gas thrust
brian_armstrong - Coinbase CEO cites TSLA perps trading after the Roadster event to argue for 24/7 tokenized stock markets
elonmusk - Musk pushes Grok Bot, sharing user posts on it phoning restaurants, ordering products by text and auditing bank accounts
chamath - NY restaurant count fell ~2,000 year over year in Q1 2026, the worst drop in at least 36 years, per Kobeissi Letter
elonmusk - Musk says X is at all-time high usage, citing Similarweb's 13.43B visits in Q3 2026, up 6% on the quarter
steipete - Post on Amazon staff tuning out suspected AI-written 6-page memos, now tagged 'AI;DR' (AI, didn't read)
